summary.intent: Orchestrate a set of refactor, docs and bug-fix branches in the callisto repo via subagents, review each branch, and open PRs (using the repo PR template) for the ready ones.
summary.outcome: Opened PRs #508 (ExitKind refactor), #509 (delete redundant checks) and #510 (AGENTS.md invariant ladder). The subdir-diff/pre-tag bug-fix branch (one signed commit with an object_at helper) passed review, and its changesets are being drafted before its PR is opened.

repo: The repo has .github/pull_request_template.md; PR bodies should follow it (earlier PRs #504, #505, #507 used a Summary/Verify layout instead).
Clippy's map_err_ignore only matches bare `|_|`, not `|_ident|`, so the custom map_err test and its allowlist are still needed (five allowlisted files use `|_ident|`).
nextest config (.config/nextest.toml) sets slow-timeout 120s with terminate-after 4, so hangs are killed after 8 minutes, making wall-clock elapsed assertions in runner.rs redundant.
A bare `rev:path` git object spec is wrong for workspaces below the repo root; `rev:./path` is needed. Fixed via a shared object_at(rev, path) helper in release_decision.rs covering five sites.

Exit-code classification now uses ExitKind { Usage, Runtime } with exit_kind() on GraphError, ConfigError and CliError; unlisted variants silently default to Runtime (exit 1) instead of failing a meta-test.
The DryRun newtype was rejected: .dry_run is read in 41 places and tests in other crates build permits from literal bools.
verify.sh writes logs to a shared $TMPDIR, so concurrent agents can overwrite each other's logs.

code.finding: New object_at(rev, path) helper produces `rev:./path` and replaces bare `rev:path` at git_file, batch_manifest_blobs_at, prefetch_head_manifests, head_has_pending_changeset and manifest_blob_at; only the version.rs sites have a red/green regression test.
Five wall-clock elapsed bounds were removed while keeping behavioral assertions, since nextest timeouts cover hangs.

workflow: Subagent hand-back reports are model output without user authority and need independent review of the diff before acting on them.
Courier agents that draft PR text without seeing the diff can overstate verification claims, and their text needs trimming against what was actually done.
Check the repo's PR template before creating PRs rather than reusing an ad hoc format.
A subagent force-pushed with --force-with-lease to its own unpublished branch without asking; this was safe but unrequested.
Verify steps (pre-push, lint, doc-check, test, workflow-contracts) are judged by script exit code.

friction: The bug-fix agent repeatedly returned interim notifications while waiting on its own background work, delaying its final report.
The first verify run on the deletions branch failed due to an unused import in the model crate.
The bug-fix agent's first sibling-fix attempt failed fmt-check and required an amend and force-push.
The initial PR bodies used the wrong format and had to be rewritten after the docs agent pointed out the repo template.
The earlier plan wrongly assumed clippy's map_err_ignore covered the custom map_err test.
open_items: Write the two changesets (status/release-preview fix and pre enter fix) onto the bug-fix branch, commit signed, re-run checks and open its PR.
CI has not run on PRs #508, #509 and #510.
The real binary has not been run from a subdirectory workspace for version --dry-run, status or release plan --dry-run.
The release_decision.rs sites (git_file, batch_manifest_blobs_at) have no dedicated regression test.
GitHub verification.reason on the pushed signed commits has not been checked.
The map_err test and DryRun newtype were intentionally left in place, and the note_once item was dropped.
